content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's Degree in Natural Sciences, Life Sciences or related discipline from a recognised University or equivalent Upper age limit: 35 years (as on date of Walk-In-Interview/Video Conferencing) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PWD As per government rules Other conditions: Initial contract appointment will normally be for a period as specified, further extension depends on project requirements and performance. Desirable: Extraction of bioactive molecules from marine animal or plant sources Isolation and purification of bioactive compounds using solvent extraction and chromatographic techniques (Column chromatography, TLC, HPLC, or related) Characterization of bioactive molecules by cell-based assay National Eligibility Tests (CSIR-UGC NET including Lectureship/Assistant Professorship) or GATE or selection process through national-level examinations conducted by central government departments and their agencies
